overview: Tomato is one of the most widely cultivated vegetable crops in India, valued for both fresh consumption and processing. It is a day-neutral warm-season crop sensitive to frost and waterlogging.
overview_hindi: टमाटर भारत में सबसे व्यापक रूप से उगाई जाने वाली सब्जियों में से एक है। यह पाला और जलभराव के प्रति संवेदनशील गर्म मौसम की फसल है।

growing_conditions.temperature_range: 21°C to 28°C (Optimal for fruit set: 20-25°C day, 15-20°C night)
growing_conditions.soil_type: Deep, well-drained sandy loam to clay loam rich in organic matter

north_india_plains.autumn_winter_crop: Nursery: June-July | Transplanting: July-August | Harvest: November-February
north_india_plains.spring_summer_crop: Nursery: November-December | Transplanting: January-February | Harvest: April-June

north_india_hills.summer_autumn_crop: Nursery: March-April | Transplanting: April-May | Harvest: July-October

central_and_western_india.kharif: Nursery: June | Transplanting: July | Harvest: October-December
central_and_western_india.rabi: Nursery: September-October | Transplanting: October-November | Harvest: January-April

south_india.year_round: Transplanted almost year-round; peak windows in June-July and October-November

duration_and_harvest.nursery_period: 25 to 30 days (seedlings reach 10-15 cm with 4-5 true leaves)
duration_and_harvest.harvest_stages: Green mature (for long-distance transport), Turning/Pink (local market), Fully ripe (processing/immediate kitchen use)

water_management.frequency: Winter: every 7-10 days; Summer: every 4-5 days. Avoid wetting leaves to prevent fungal infection.
water_management.method_recommendation: Drip irrigation with fertigation saves 40-50% water and reduces foliar disease pressure by 60%.

nutrient_management.organic_manure: 20-25 tonnes/hectare well-decomposed FYM or compost applied during final land preparation
nutrient_management.fertilizer_npk_standard: 100-120 kg N : 60-80 kg P2O5 : 60-80 kg K2O per hectare (for open-pollinated varieties); 150:100:120 for indeterminate hybrids
nutrient_management.application_schedule: Apply full P, full K, and 1/3 N as basal dose. Apply remaining N in two equal splits at 30 days and 50 days after transplanting.
nutrient_management.calcium_boron_note: Foliar application of Calcium Nitrate (0.5%) prevents Blossom End Rot (BER) during heavy fruit set.

diseases.name: Early Blight
symptoms: Dark brown to black spots with concentric rings ('bullseye' or target pattern) on older lower leaves first
Yellow chlorotic halo around leaf spots
Leaves turn yellow, dry out, and drop prematurely (defoliation)
Dark sunken cankers on stems and collar region
diseases.favorable_conditions: Warm temperatures (24-30°C) with alternating dry and wet periods or heavy dew
prevention_and_cultural: Use certified disease-free seeds or seedlings
Practice 2-3 year crop rotation with non-solanaceous crops (avoid potato, brinjal, chilli)
Prune lower bottom leaves (up to 30 cm from ground) to improve airflow
Avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation; water at soil level
Mulch with clean straw or plastic to prevent soil splash onto lower foliage
diseases.basic_organic_care: Remove and burn affected lower leaves at earliest sign. Spray Trichoderma viride or Pseudomonas fluorescens (5g/L) as a bio-protective measure. For chemical fungicidal confirmation, consult local KVK.

diseases.name: Late Blight
symptoms: Water-soaked, pale green to brown irregular lesions on leaf edges and tips
White cottony/frosty mold growth on leaf undersides under high humidity
Rapid browning and collapse of stems and leaves (looks like frost or fire burn)
Firm, brown, greasy lesions on green fruits
diseases.favorable_conditions: Cool temperatures (15-20°C) and persistent high relative humidity (>90%) with fog or drizzle
prevention_and_cultural: Provide wide plant spacing (60 x 45 cm or 75 x 60 cm for staked hybrids) to ensure good air circulation
Immediately rogue (uproot) and destroy infected plants outside the field
Avoid planting tomato immediately adjacent to potato crops
Staking/trellising plants to keep foliage off wet ground
diseases.basic_organic_care: Bordeaux mixture (1%) or Copper Oxychloride spray upon disease forewarning in cool wet weather. Seek certified agricultural extension advice for emergency fungicidal intervention.

diseases.name: Leaf Mold
symptoms: Pale green to yellowish patches on upper leaf surfaces
Olive green to velvety brown fuzzy fungal growth on the matching lower leaf surface
In severe cases, leaves wither and drop, reducing photosynthetic area
diseases.favorable_conditions: High relative humidity (>85%) and moderate temperatures (20-24°C), common in polyhouses and dense plantings
prevention_and_cultural: Ensure ventilation in polyhouses and green shade nets
Reduce planting density and prune suckers to promote air circulation
Drip irrigation to keep leaves dry
diseases.basic_organic_care: Remove diseased leaves promptly. Bio-fungicide spray of Bacillus subtilis or Trichoderma viride.

diseases.name: Septoria Leaf Spot
symptoms: Numerous small circular spots (2-3 mm) with dark brown margins and sunken grayish-white centers
Tiny black fruiting specks (pycnidia) visible inside older spot centers with a hand lens
Starts on oldest leaves after fruit set and works upward
diseases.favorable_conditions: Warm and wet weather with rain splashing spores from soil onto leaves
prevention_and_cultural: Crop rotation for at least 2 years without solanaceous crops
Organic straw mulching to block soil splash
Avoid handling or weeding wet plants to prevent spreading spores
diseases.basic_organic_care: Neem oil emulsion (5 ml/L with soap water) or copper-based protective sprays under agricultural extension guidance.

diseases.name: Healthy Tomato
symptoms: Uniformly vibrant green foliage without spots, yellow halos, or lesions
Sturdy erect stems with healthy branching
Normal blossom clusters and firm fruit development
maintenance_tips: Maintain uniform soil moisture; avoid water stress during flowering
Apply balanced NPK and organic compost at 30-day intervals
Keep staking clean and scout fields twice a week for early pest detection
